name: setup-manaflow-ai-grid
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces, redesigned on a strict grid. Theme files make every surface one opaque color parted only by 1 px rules, with square pane corners, no glass, no blur and no wallpaper, one accent for Send, focus and the work dot, and every height on 8 px steps (Grid, dark, the default; Grid Light; Grid Signal). Settings set the chat and the Markdown viewer in Hanken Grotesk at 16 px on a 24 px line in a 768 px column, toasts as flat bars, and a square address field. A stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens draws cards as ruled boxes with no fill and the prompt as a square box ruled in the ink. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Grid sidebar" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Grid's hover card and sidebar rows: a bold title over a rule, then one fact per line on the 8 px grid, and semibold rows with a still dot while work runs.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1", "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
files.themes/grid-light.json:
// Grid Light: the Swiss grid on white. A white page and black ink, no second surface: the
// sidebar, tabs and panes are the same white, parted only by 1 px rules of the ink at 20%. One
// accent, a deep ultramarine, for Send, focus and the work dot, and nothing else. Zero corners, no
// shadow, no glass, no wallpaper; every height on the 8 px grid.
{
  "name": "Grid Light",
  "description": "White page, black ink, 1 px rules, ultramarine accent, zero corners, no glass.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Light",
  // The window, sidebar and pages take this theme too, over an App Theme of your own.
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  // Page, ink, the terminal's selection and the one accent; then the terminal palette, whole.
  "colors": {
    "background": "#ffffff",
    "foreground": "#000000",
    "selection": "#d6d6d6",
    "accent": "#0038e0",
    "0": "#000000",
    "1": "#d0021b",
    "2": "#257c3a",
    "3": "#876804",
    "4": "#396cb7",
    "5": "#995297",
    "6": "#04787e",
    "7": "#6e7279",
    "8": "#878b93",
    "9": "#d0021b",
    "10": "#058549",
    "11": "#906f04",
    "12": "#4770cc",
    "13": "#ac529d",
    "14": "#01808c",
    "15": "#939599",
    "cursor": "#0038e0"
  },
  // The accent above is the only hue the chrome draws.
  "appearance.accent": "theme",
  // The selected row and tab are a gray block, not an accent tint: the accent stays for action.
  "appearance.selection": "neutral",
  "terminal.fontFamily": "SF Mono",
  "terminal.fontSize": 13,

  // Opaque: no wallpaper, no blur, no glass anywhere.
  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "none",
  "browser.omnibar.glass": "off",
  "ui.reducedBackgrounds": true,
  "appearance.fontSmoothing": "antialiased",

  // Rules, not cards: no curved main pane, one color edge to edge, a 1 px line between panes and on
  // the sidebar's edge. Square pane corners with no inset.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat",
  "appearance.borders": "default",
  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "oneColor",
  "appearance.cornerFlush": "flush",
  "appearance.focusIndicator": "both",
  "layout.paneCornerRadius": 0,
  "layout.cornerPadding": 0,
  "layout.paneBorderWidth": 1,
  "appearance.metrics.dividerThickness": 1,

  // The sidebar on the page's own color behind its 1 px rule; sections parted by rules.
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "same",
  "sidebar.border": true,
  "sidebar.borderWidth": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "lines",

  // Every surface is the page. The rules between panes are the ink at a fixed step.
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.editor.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.editor.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.diff.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.diff.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.settings.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.settings.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.home.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.home.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.browserChrome.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.browserChrome.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.docks.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.docks.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.color": "#cccccc",
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.opacity": 1,

  // Work in progress: a dot in the accent that holds still.
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "dot",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.animation": "static",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#0038e0",

  // The 8 px grid: a 256 px sidebar, 32 px rows, a 40 px title bar, a 32 px tab strip, 8 px gaps.
  "appearance.density": "compact",
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarWidth": 256,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowHeight": 32,
  "appearance.metrics.titlebarHeight": 40,
  "appearance.metrics.tabStripHeight": 32,
  "appearance.metrics.tabFontSize": 13,
  "appearance.metrics.tabMaxWidth": 200,
  "appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize": 13,
  "appearance.metrics.columnGap": 8,

  // Motion: quick and plain.
  "ui.animationSpeed": "fast"
}
